review_scope: Redis rate limits, jobs, and worker heartbeat
health, security, observability, CI, PWA, and runbooks

acceptance_hardening.finding: A legacy SQLite database was stamped at Alembic head while missing authentication ownership and refresh-token columns.
acceptance_hardening.correction: Readiness validates critical authentication schema columns, the recovery runbook forbids stamping as repair, and live browser acceptance covers registration, logout, login, restoration, and safe rejection.
